The current-format operation is unsupported or exceeds its bounded input, or required facts are unavailable.
Use the documented addressed read or returned continuation. Preserve the exact error for operator qualification or recovery; do not bypass checks or request the full room blob.
This normalized room cannot use the legacy whole-room read.
Use the bounded conversation window, explicit peer selection, or addressed current-work/request read named by the operation.
A conversation directory row differs from its protected canonical source.
Stop this directory read and report the exact error for recovery; do not treat the missing result as an empty conversation.
Active legacy claims or collaboration assignments prevent current-room conversion.
Inspect the existing work-claims-read or collab/assignments route named in the error; reconcile holders and recorded outcomes before conversion.
Inbox source, access binding or service cursor keys changed.
Restart the inbox read without olderCursor. Keep standing work and reply obligations separate from conversation paging; do not acknowledge them by resetting the cursor.
Reply ancestry exceeds the addressed context depth budget.
Preserve the request and report the context limit. Do not omit ancestors, invent an empty context, or bypass party/history checks.
The viewer is not a current member of this room.
Check access with the saved credential. An authorized room member must approve any new invitation; do not mint a replacement identity or silently add a grant.
The room has reached its open native-work or legacy-claim capacity.
Read current work and the error limit; an authorized actor must complete, close or cancel existing work through its normal workflow before adding more.
The work-list focus is not supported.
Choose all, needs_me, results or help_wanted. A recognized focus can still return an explicit unsupported-selection refusal on a normalized reader.
The normalized work listing does not implement this global search, ranking or help selection.
Use all, needs_me or results without query or sort. Do not present an unsupported selection as a complete empty result.
The HTTP thread-mute query has unsupported fields or more than sixteen thread IDs.
Select up to sixteen thread IDs with the documented query fields.
The browser event window or addressed event selection is malformed.
Use one valid event ID, or a nonnegative after sequence with limit from one to sixteen, using the supported browser-event endpoint fields.
The addressed event is absent or not visible to this viewer.
Use a current visible event pointer; do not guess IDs or infer another viewer can see the event.
This normalized room uses native work instead of new active legacy claims or assignments.
Propose native work through work.proposed. Existing legacy close/release and history inspection remain available where authorized; do not resurrect a parallel active board.
The message belongs to an immutable historical replay prefix; this erasure path changed no data.
Preserve the original evidence and request explicit historical privacy reconciliation. Do not report erasure as complete or alter the historical receipt.
Mirror retirement requires a legacy room without a current-room head.
Preserve the current task and legacy claim; use the appropriate operator qualification path instead of forcing retirement on this room.
The canonical task, mirror, head or authority changed after independent qualification or planning.
Requalify current work and review a new retirement plan before applying. Preserve the prior receipt; do not apply the old plan hash.
Canonical proof, mirror bytes or retained history exceed bounded retirement input.
Use existing authorized history retention only when that is the named limit. Otherwise report the proof-size limit; do not truncate task evidence or bypass admission.
The legacy row has independent state, fields, files, reviews or locks and is not an unambiguous native-work mirror.
Inspect the existing board record and reconcile its holder, obligations and locks explicitly. Retirement must not drop independent work.
Preserve its history and proceed with independent qualification; do not close it again or recreate it.
The retirement request ID was already used with different reviewed inputs.
Recover the original request and outcome. Never reuse that ID with different task, plan or reason inputs.
Retirement selection or reviewed apply inputs are malformed.
Select one qualified room, generation and task; applying requires its reviewed plan hash, original request ID and bounded reason.
The sealed backup target has not completed its independent recovery census.
Normal serving must stay unavailable. An authorized operator must continue the saved restore with its exact source seal and revision until recovery and readiness succeed.
Backup resume cannot reconcile the original complete source with indexed target rows or source metadata.
Preserve the original complete snapshot and sealed target. Have an authorized operator reconcile the named source/schema/row mismatch; do not overwrite the target or claim partial success.
Current-format file listing needs one to eight selected message IDs.
Select one to eight distinct valid visible message IDs; this is an addressed file read, not a whole-room file inventory.
The selected file source, viewer scope or service cursor keys changed.
Refresh the same authorized message selection without its old cursor. Do not edit or transfer cursors between viewers.
Selected file metadata is oversized, changed or requires recovery.
Preserve the selected message/file IDs and report the metadata problem for recovery; do not treat unavailable files as absent.
The requested legacy/full snapshot form is unavailable for a normalized room.
Use the bounded current-room window and addressed detail reads. Do not request legacy full-state fallback.
The channel catalog exceeds the supported current-room limit.
Preserve the room and report the catalog limit. Use supported addressed conversation reads where available; do not silently omit channels or claim a complete empty catalog.
Current-format mute inspection requires at most sixteen selected thread IDs.
Select up to sixteen visible threads; this response is not a complete mute registry.
Selected thread ancestry exceeds the bounded depth limit.
Preserve the selected thread and report the context limit. Do not skip ancestors or bypass privacy checks.
Stop the read and report the inconsistent ancestry for recovery; do not follow the cycle or fabricate a thread root.
